data_description.mower_entity: The lawn_mower entity this instance controls: started, docked, and watched for its current state.
data_description.temperature_entity: Drives the Growth Potential model and the heat lockout. Required - growth can't be estimated without it.

weather.title: Weather sensors (optional, recommended)
weather.description: Leave fields empty if a sensor is not available yet.

data_description.rain_rate_entity: Detects rain as it's happening: blocks mowing above the rain-stop threshold and docks a mow already in progress. Without it, active rain isn't detected at all - only past rain, if rain_amount_entity is set.
data_description.rain_amount_entity: Tracks recent rainfall. Used to keep mowing blocked for a while after rain stops (grass still wet), and - only if no soil-moisture sensor is set - to dampen growth after a run of dry days. Without it, neither applies.
data_description.humidity_entity: Currently collected for diagnostics only; not factored into any mowing or growth decision yet.
data_description.dewpoint_entity: Combined with the temperature sensor to detect dew (mowing pauses when the two are close together). Without it, morning dew on the grass isn't detected.
data_description.soil_moisture_entity: Dampens growth proportionally as the soil dries out, and blocks mowing outright below the drought threshold (options). Without it, drought protection falls back to the coarser rain-amount-based rule, or is off entirely if that's not set either.
data_description.solar_radiation_entity: Dampens growth on overcast days. Without it, growth is calculated as if it were always full sun.

data_description.irrigation_entities: Any switch/binary_sensor/valve that's on while a zone is watering. Blocks mowing during and shortly after irrigation. Without one, irrigation isn't taken into account at all.
data_description.irrigation_lockout_hours: How long mowing stays blocked after the last irrigation entity turns off.
